rule: Day 3 (pick>=103) or UDFA: when two rushers' no-tracking forecasts are within 0.5 pressure-rate points, prefer the higher year-standardized Hoop G; otherwise follow the forecast
forecast: OLS of shrunk career pressure rate on log pick, weight, EDGE share, NGS athleticism, official 10-yd split, 3-cone, fit on other classes
test: primary: 2026 Combine class after its first NFL season, slope of Hoop G on (pressure rate - frozen forecast), within-class permutation, one-sided p<0.10; slope <= 0 drops Hoop G. Secondary: tied-pair win rate of Hoop G vs 50%
recheck: after the 2026 regular season with 2026 pressure counts; flip rates in board
